candidate.definition_en: To rule as a monarch, or to predominate and prevail in a particular situation.
candidate.explanation_ar: يحكم ويسيطر كملك، أو تسود حالة معينة وتنتشر (مثل سيادة الفوضى أو الهدوء).

senses.definition_en: To hold royal office and rule as a king, queen, or emperor.
examples: The new king will reign with fairness and justice.

senses.definition_en: To predominate, prevail, or be the dominant feature or power.
examples: If negotiations fail, chaos will reign across the region.
The team hopes to reign supreme in the tournament this year.
The new king will reign with fairness and justice.
If negotiations fail, chaos will reign across the region.
The team hopes to reign supreme in the tournament this year.
